question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase, whether monitoring periods in Federal FY2025 are subject to the footnote *10 effluent limits (30-day average 497 mg/L and 27,664 lbs/day) or the footnote *11 effluent limits (30-day average 449 mg/L and 24,992 lbs/day), including whether FY2025 spans the transition between those phased limit periods.
required_context: monitoring period dates within Federal FY2025
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page 5, Section part_i, table row Total Dissolved Solids Net Increase (*8), footnotes *10 and *11
notes: The nominated row pairs numeric limits marked *10 with a second row carrying different numeric limits marked *11; which row governs FY2025 monitoring periods determines the applicable enforceable limits for compliance comparison under Purpose A.
